Far,Ⓒa.ⒹdUra (with abl. or gen.), viprakfzwa; See Distant; ‘f(ar) from comfort’ suKAdapeta.
Ⓔadv.ⒹdUraM-re ArAt (with abl.), vidUrataH, atyaMtaM, BfSaM, atIva, su-ati pr.; ‘f(ar) away’ dUre, sudUraM; ‘from f(ar)’ dUrAt, dUrataH (eva); [] ‘how f(ar)’ kiyaddUraM, kiyatyaDvani; kiyat-pramARaM, kiMparyaMtaM, kiyatAMSena; ‘f(ar) off’ dUra, dUrasTa, dUravartin, dUrasTAyin; ‘as f(ar) as’ ex. by A with abl. or in comp.; ‘as f(ar) as the sea’ AsamudrAt or AsamudraM; oft. by yAvat (with acc.) or paryaMta in comp.; ‘so far as’, ‘as f(ar) as’ iti; See under As ‘not f(ar) from the tree’ tasya vfkzyasya nAtidUre; ‘by f(ar)’ BUyasA; ‘your statement is not f(ar) from the truth’ BUtArTakalpaM tava vacaH; ‘f(ar) gone in love’ dUragatamanmaTA (

). In comp. ex. by ati, bahu, dUra; ‘f(ar)-extended’ bahuvistIrRa; ‘f(ar)-famed’ praTitayaSas, urukIrti; ‘f(ar)-fetched’ klizwa, yatnakfta, asugama, asukara; ‘f(ar)-reaching’ dUrADirUQa, ‘f(ar)-seeing’, ‘f(ar)-sighted’ dUradarSin, dIrGadfzwi, dUradfzwi.
